en.answer: In this case, <<7491>> is not treated as a "Fluffal" monster when it is sent to the Graveyard, so you cannot activate <<11743>>.
en.question: If <<7491>> has changed its name to <<11348>> by its own effect, and is then destroyed by my opponent's <<5544>>, can I activate <<11743>>?
en.title: If <<7491>> has changed its name to <<11348>> by its own effect, and is then destroyed by my opponent's <<5544>>, can I activate <<11743>>?

ja.answer:
質問の状況の場合、「<<7491>>」が墓地へ送られた扱いとなり、「<<11348>>」が墓地へ送られた扱いにはなりません。

したがって、「<<11743>>」を発動する事はできません。
